longTitle.officialTitle: To amend title 36, United States Code, to encourage the nationwide observance of two minutes of silence each Veterans Day.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Veterans Day Moment of Silence Act”.

subsection.heading: Two Minutes of Silence.—
Clerical Amendment.—
subsection.content:
The table of sections for chapter 1 of title 36, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new item:
“145. Veterans Day.” .
